question: Which of the following is the largest Stupa in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kesariya Stupa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kesariya Stupa:-**

 
 
• **It is located in Kesariya, Champaran district of Bihar, India. It is the tallest Buddhist stupa in India, standing at a height of 104 feet (32 meters). **
 
• The stupa dates back to the 3rd century BCE and was built during the Mauryan Empire in northern India.
 
• The stupa was originally 70 feet (21 meters) tall, but it has been renovated several times in later centuries.
 
• The stupa has a globular base divided into seven stages around it. Each stage is painted a different color, and each stage is adorned with numerous sculptures of Buddhist gods and goddesses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanchi Stupa:-**

 
 
• It is a Buddhist monument located in Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• **It is one of the oldest stone structures in India, and was originally commissioned by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka the Great in the 3rd century BCE. **
 
• The stupa is a hemispherical structure that contains the relics of the Buddha.
 
• It is surrounded by four gateways, each of which is decorated with intricate carvings. The Sanchi Stupa is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
 
 
• **Maha Stupa:-**
 
 
• It is a Buddhist monument located in Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka.
 
• **It is one of the largest stupas in the world, and is said to contain the relics of the Buddha. **
 
• The Maha Stupa was built in the 3rd century BCE, and was later rebuilt and enlarged several times. The stupa is a symbol of the power and importance of Buddhism in Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• **Shanti Stupa:-**
 
 
• **It is a Buddhist monument located in Rajagiri, India. It was built in 1963 by the Japanese monk Nichidatsu Fujii as a symbol of peace. **
 
• The stupa is made of white marble and has a gold-plated spire.
 
• The Shanti Stupa is a popular tourist destination, and is also a place of pilgrimage for Buddhists from around the world.
